_about: Slug to Google Doc id(s) and published digest, as specified in docs/gdocs-sync-design.md (sections 4 and 6, D7 and D9). Hand-written for the pilot via the Drive connector; the design makes this file generated by gdocs_publish.py. Per D12 it belongs in the private notes repo; it is here only because this session cannot reach notes.

constitution-husserl-ideas-ii-study.body_note: Body is the source file with the Jekyll front matter stripped; published_sha256 is the digest of the file as it stands in the repo.
constitution-husserl-ideas-ii-study.app_properties_note: D9 identity (appProperties src/part/published_sha256) is not set: the Drive connector cannot write appProperties. Lookup is by doc_id here until gdocs_publish.py exists.
